packages.name: esbuild
packages.justification: esbuild postinstall downloads platform-specific binary. Required by Vite/turborepo build toolchain.

packages.name: protobufjs
packages.justification: protobufjs postinstall generates runtime JS files from .proto definitions. Transitive dependency of @stellar/stellar-sdk.

denied.name: core-js
denied.justification: core-js's postinstall only prints a funding banner (node -e "try{require('./postinstall')}catch(e){}"). Deliberately withheld from pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies so pnpm blocks it. Transitive dependency of jspdf -> canvg.
